_note: Register fragment for theme-archive-hotspot (REQ-THA-001). An administrator marks a subject as an archive hotspot, with the reason; ThemeHotspotListener stamps archiveHotspotSince and sets the subject's OpenRegister appraisal to permanent. No later fragment in name order declares the theme schema, so this one carries the version bump.

archiveHotspot.title: Archive hotspot
archiveHotspot.description: Every publication filed under this subject is kept permanently.

archiveHotspotReason.title: Reason for the archive hotspot
archiveHotspotReason.description: Why this subject is an archive hotspot, for example the list that names it.

archiveHotspotSince.title: Archive hotspot since
archiveHotspotSince.description: When the subject was marked as an archive hotspot.
